meta.description:
# H5N1 clade 2.3.4.4b, US HA timetree with phenotype overlays

This interactive Auspice dataset is based on the 13,000-tip dated HA tree and a per-strain phenotype table.

## What changed in this kit

- Removed confusing legacy variant fields:
  - variant_count
  - variant_num
  - variant_num_rep
- Added two simpler variant views:
  - `variant_all` = all variants as V1 ... V2195
  - `variant_top10` = top 10 variants by observed frequency, all remaining variants grouped as `Other`
- Applied **2nd-98th percentile clipping** to continuous phenotype columns in the visualization metadata so outliers do not dominate color scaling.

## Important note

The metadata used by Auspice in this kit is visualization-oriented:
continuous phenotype values have been clipped to the 2nd-98th percentile range for display.

The file `metadata_13000_nextstrain_unclipped.tsv` is also included for reference if you want the raw un-clipped values.
